messages:
Alina: Quick sync — Google marketplace team wants a GKE + Cloud Armor reference that demonstrates a secure one-click deploy for Redwood Dedicated. I pushed a draft TF module to refkit (branch: feature/marketplace-gke-armor). Who can review the networking + k8s details?
Sam: I can take the Terraform + networking review. Share the link to the branch pls.
Alina: https://github.com/redwood/refkit/compare/feature/marketplace-gke-armor — the README is skeletoned, module under modules/gke-marketplace. Needs examples and a diagram for the marketplace listing.
Priya: Quick thought — do we expose an external IP directly or wire up ILB + GCLB with Cloud Armor? Marketplace prefers simple, one-click installs but also wants WAF defaults.
Miguel: Recommend GCLB (HTTP(S) Load Balancer) + NEG for the k8s service + Cloud Armor in front. Keeps public TLS on the LB and lets us attach a security policy. ILB for private setups is fine but market listing should show the public path.
Sam: Agreed. I'll refactor the module to create a backend NEG, health checks, and a managed cert resource. Also add a boolean var to switch autoprovisioning.
Alina: Marketplace also requested a quickstart that uses GKE Standard (not Autopilot) to avoid nodePort edge cases and to demonstrate RBAC setup. Can we include a minimal tf example that provisions a cluster + deploys our helm chart?
Sam: I'll add a quickstart under examples/quickstart-gke with a terraform snippet. Dropping a minimal snippet now for Jordan to use in the doc: 
```hcl
module "gke_cluster" {
  source = "../modules/gke-marketplace"
  project = var.project
  region  = var.region
  cluster_name = "redwood-marketplace-gke"
  enable_autoprovisioning = false
  create_ingress = true
}
```
Priya: For Cloud Armor, recommend a starter policy that does: block known malicious IP ranges, enable preconfigured WAF rules, and a simple rate limit for /api/* routes. I have a sample policy we can include.
Miguel: Ping — make sure the NEG uses container port 8080 by default and that the health check path is /_health. Marketplace customers copy-paste, so pick sensible defaults.
CI-bot: CI passed for branch feature/marketplace-gke-armor — build #122 ✅
Jordan: I'll draft the architecture diagram and the marketplace listing screenshots. Sam, can you paste the actual terraform example (with outputs) that I can embed into the listing? Prefer minimal copy-paste.
Sam: Will do — I'll add outputs for kubeconfig, load_balancer_ip, and cloud_armor_policy_name. Also will add a short troubleshooting section for common GKE quota errors.
Alina: Action items: Sam — update module and add examples (due EOD Wed). Priya — attach Cloud Armor policy snippet + rules (due Thu). Miguel — validate NEG/health-check defaults and run a quick smoke deploy in our test project (due Thu). Jordan — diagram + screenshots (due Fri). We'll sync again after PR is green. Thanks all :thumbsup:
